title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky reflects on her past, recalling how when she was running in the Twinkle Series, her opponents began avoiding her in competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When a fellow racer confessed that she felt her future growing dimmer when they ran together, something inside Maruzensky seemed to break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then she met Sakura Chiyono O, who appeared in front of her and declared she wanted to be like Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why she decided to accept Sakura Chiyono O as her successor, passing down all of her unfulfilled dreams and regrets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Sakura Chiyono O voices her own wish, swearing that she won't lose to her rivals, and that she'll fulfill the dream Maruzensky gave her.
